text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, in front of a golf shop at the 
shopping mall—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hrrrrm, I can't decide...! Which one 
should I pick~...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see~... There's this super cool 
brand that I absolutely adore at this 
shop—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"They got new clubs from FULL&BW in stock, 
so I hopped right over, thrilled to buy 
them!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, they're so popular there's a 
purchase limit. Only one bottle per flavor 
per person, apparently~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, love it! It all started back when I 
was little and my dad taught me~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
At first, it just felt like an extension 
of playtime, using the mansion's courtyard 
as our track, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm completely hooked, and I obsess 
over every single piece of merch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And, well, that's how it is... So I'm 
having a hard time picking one~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I ran and ran until I narrowed it down to 
two choices, but... There's no escaping 
this final decision now...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A tenacious, reliable wedge, or betting 
everything on the power of a driver……?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Considering all the front-running guts 
we've held onto this far, yeah, that might 
definitely be the one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna go buy it before it 
sells out! Thanks for tagging along~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Front-running guts"... It's an oddly 
memorable turn of phrase.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Considering all the front-runner power 
we've stretched out this far, yeah, that 
might definitely be the one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna go buy it before it 
sells out! Thanks for tagging along~!
